youtube.title: Zoomy's Car Colors! Learn Colors (HONK!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🚗 HONK! Zoomy the car honked so loud that all the colorful car friends zoomed away! Can you help Zoomy find them?

Learn colors with Zoomy and the car friends: RED, ORANGE, YELLOW, GREEN, PURPLE and PINK! Zoomy drives down the road, past the farm, through the city, the forest, the snow and the park, and every car friend answers with a REAL car sound. Then sing Zoomy's color song, and stay till the end, because one more car is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 6 colors: red, orange, yellow, green, purple and pink
✔️ Match each color word to a colorful car
✔️ Hear real car and bus sounds
✔️ Sing a driving color song with Zoomy!
